```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r audits}
library(easyNIS)
library(dplyr)
library(srvyr)

nis <- nis_open(nis_example(years = 2015))
nis_audit_code_transition(
  nis, codes = c(heart_failure = "I50"), type = "dx", system = "icd10",
  by = c(YEAR, DQTR)
)
nis_audit_dx_position(nis, "I50", system = "icd10", outcomes = DIED)
```

The examples use invented data. The transition audit counts matches by
quarter in the ICD-10 diagnosis slots. Use a separate audit with
`system = "icd9"` and the corresponding ICD-9 prefixes for earlier quarters.
The position audit compares principal, secondary-only, and
any-position definitions. Both give descriptive counts or rates. Use a
survey design for standard errors.

## The 2012 redesign

Starting in 2012, the NIS samples discharges across hospitals in its sampling
frame. Earlier releases sampled hospitals and retained their discharges.
For a trend spanning the redesign, HCUP supplies `TRENDWT` for the applicable
pre-2012 data. Use `DISCWT` from 2012 onward. easyNIS handles 2012 and later
and does not apply historical trend weights.
[HCUP trend weight guidance](https://hcup-us.ahrq.gov/db/nation/nis/trendwghts.jsp)

## The October 2015 coding change

Quarters 1 through 3 of 2015 use ICD-9-CM. Quarter 4 uses ICD-10-CM for
diagnoses and ICD-10-PCS for procedures. Specify separate code sets for
the two systems. `system = "both"` requires separate ICD-9 and ICD-10 slots.
Review matches by quarter before interpreting a change in prevalence.
[HCUP NIS documentation](https://hcup-us.ahrq.gov/db/nation/nis/nisdbdocumentation.jsp)

## Quarter coverage

Aggregate by `YEAR` and `DQTR` to see which quarters contribute. With
`DQTR` available, `nis_design()` flags incomplete coverage during annualization
and identifies a cohort restricted to one 2015 coding era. The annualization
divisor counts a partial year once. Report a quarter-specific or era-specific
estimate as such.

## The 2023 and 2024 Core layouts

The package uses the Core layouts from the HCUP SAS load programs.
`TOTCHG_2023` and `TOTCHG_2024` are separate from the earlier `TOTCHG` field.
Select the charge field for the year you analyze and check comparability
before combining fields. The package layouts for these years have been
checked against the load programs. Conversion on licensed annual files for
these layouts has yet to be verified.
[HCUP NIS load programs](https://hcup-us.ahrq.gov/db/nation/sasloadprog.jsp)

## Annual links for companions and cost-to-charge ratios

Join the Hospital file by `YEAR` and `HOSP_NIS` and the Severity file by
`YEAR` and `KEY_NIS`. Obtain the matching [HCUP cost-to-charge ratio
file](https://hcup-us.ahrq.gov/db/ccr/ip-ccr/ip-ccr.jsp) for each data year.
Prepare it with the hospital key in its release documentation, then link
by `YEAR` and `HOSP_NIS`. Check which years and hospitals lack a match.
